description: This Java interface defines API endpoints for managing documents within the Fineract project, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and downloading document files. It was generated by OpenAPI Generator and manually edited to address specific issues, serving as a client-side service interface for document-related operations.

classes.name: DocumentsApiFixed
classes.description: A Retrofit Java interface providing methods to interact with document-related endpoints of the API, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and downloading documents.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document associated with a specific entity type and ID, using multipart form data to upload the file and optional metadata.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a specific document by its document ID for the given entity and entity ID.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads the binary file attached to a specific document.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information for a specific document.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Lists all documents associated with a specific entity.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates an existing document, optionally replacing its file and metadata.
